    The deck transformation of the degree of a row #

    Proof of Lemma A.2(1) (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): "Lift a row path from τ(x, j). Its endpoint has the form (ρ^l x, j - sl)." For a deck generator g (v, t) = (ρ v, t + c₀), a row of length m + 1 lifts to a path from τ X to g^n X with n c₀ = m - 1.

      Rows of length m + 1 exist only in degrees c₀ ∣ m - 1, and lift to paths from τ X to g^n X with n c₀ = m - 1.
